podcast.title: Early Band Efforts
podcast.body: Formed when Tom Morello was approximately 16 or 17 years old, Electric Sheep included Adam Jones, who would later become the guitarist for Tool, playing bass. The band was noted for its enthusiastic approach and strong political convictions, despite many of its members lacking significant musical proficiency. "The bass player in the group was a guy named Adam Jones. And that's the same Adam Jones that now plays guitar in Toul."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Early Connection to Adam Jones
xref.body: While attending school in Illinois, Tom Morello was in the same class as Adam Jones, who would later become the guitarist for Tool. They also played together in early bands like Electric Sheep. "In the same class was this kid named Adam Jones. He would later grow up to be the guitarist and tool. After picking up the guitar at age 13, he played in a bunch of bands with names like Nebula and Electric Sheep, which, by the way, also featured Adam Jones."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
